title: Demystifying Hateful Content: Leveraging Large Multimodal Models for Hateful Meme Detection with Explainable Decisions
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical task of hateful meme detection using LMMs to improve classification and explainability. While the task involves identifying religious or social prejudice as part of hate speech classification, the paper does not evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, moral reasoning frameworks, or ethical systems themselves.
